cues.zh: 大家好，看看我今天收到了什么邮件。

cues.zh: 这玩意儿我等好几个月了。
cues.en: Been waiting for this for months.

cues.en: Enclosed is your OpenAI private beta API key

cues.en: Gotta make sure I blur it out.

cues.zh: 既然掌握了这种逆天神力，我就琢磨着做点什么，
cues.en: So I’ve been thinking about what to make now that I have this incredible power, and

cues.zh: 我冒出的第一个念头就是让命令行更好用，于是我开搞了。
cues.en: the first idea I had was making the command-line easier to use, so I got to work.

cues.zh: 基本思路就是，不用再为了在 Linux 命令行里完成各种任务
cues.en: Basically, the idea is that instead of constantly Googling for how to accomplish various tasks

cues.zh: 而去不停地 Google，我想要一个 AI 驱动的 Shell。
cues.en: on the command-line in Linux, I want an AI-powered shell.

cues.zh: 我告诉 Shell 我想做什么，
cues.en: I’ll tell the shell what I want to do,

cues.zh: 它就能自己琢磨出该执行什么命令。
cues.en: and the shell will figure out the actual command to run.

cues.zh: 一年下来，这能帮我日常工作省下好几分钟呢，
cues.en: Over the course of a year, this could save entire minutes from my typical workflow, and

cues.zh: 这也绝对是 AI 在淘汰人类的大业上迈出的巨大一步。
cues.en: could be a huge win for AIs in their quest to obsolete humans.

cues.zh: 如你所见，需要写的代码并不多。
cues.en: As you can see, there’s not a whole lot of code that needs to be written.

cues.zh: OpenAI 提供了访问其 API 的 Python 库，但它其实只是在做简单的
cues.en: OpenAI provides a Python library to access their API, but it’s really just doing simple

cues.zh: 底层 HTTP 请求。
cues.en: HTTP requests underneath the hood.

cues.zh: 现在，我们拿些基础的东西来试试。
cues.en: Now, let’s try it out on some basic stuff.

cues.zh: 我经常需要用一些不太熟悉的工具，所以很难记住
cues.en: Often I need to use a tool that I’m not super familiar with, so it’s hard to remember

cues.zh: 该怎么运行它。
cues.en: how to run it.

cues.zh: 尤其是在转换或处理特定文件格式时。
cues.en: Especially with converting or working with specific file formats.

cues.en: And it can help us with stuff online too:

cues.en: Note how we didn’t need to specify what filesystem type

cues.zh: 甚至不用指定要格式化哪块硬盘。
cues.en: or even which hard drive to format.

cues.zh: 这太有用了！
cues.en: That’s super helpful!

cues.zh: 它还能找出需要多个步骤的命令：
cues.en: It can also figure out commands that require multiple steps:

cues.zh: 嗯，努力值得表扬吧。
cues.en: Well, A for effort, I guess.

cues.zh: OpenAI 的模型还有个惊人的本事：编造 URL。
cues.en: OpenAI’s model also has an incredible ability to hallucinate URLs.

cues.zh: 你随便问它要个东西，它就能想象出你可能在哪儿下载。
cues.en: You can just ask it for something, and it’ll imagine where you might be able to download it.

cues.zh: 等等……OpenAI 这是刚给我来了个瑞克摇？
cues.en: Did… did OpenAI just rickroll me?

cues.en: The best part of all this is that OpenAI’s models are stochastic, which means that there’s

cues.zh: 结果里带点随机性。
cues.en: some randomness in the result.

cues.zh: 同一个请求，你可能得到不同的命令，我觉得这让我
cues.en: You might get different commands for the same request, and I find that that really keeps

cues.zh: 干活时总有种新鲜刺激感。
cues.en: things fresh and exciting while I’m working.

cues.en: I wish I could put this online for everybody to try out, but I would need approval from

cues.en: OpenAI to let more than 5 people use it, and there’s a charge for each request.
